t: The Age of Hybrid AI: Commoditized Intelligence and Sovereign Workflow
s: This article argues that AI's commoditization, exemplified by Google's price cuts, necessitates a 'Vigilant Hare' approach to workflow and personal sovereignty, integrating frontier and local AI to build 'AI-ready' systems and content amidst a 'Great Squeezing'.
sub: The 'Vigilant Hare' metaphor for iterative progress and strategic resting, contrasting with the 'tortoise' of inefficient progress.
Critique of media consumption dynamics and their impact on perception and 'wheel-spinning'.
The heresy of isolated genius vs. collaborative innovation, exemplified by Grothendieck and Serre.
Leveraging AI to reduce friction and enable individuals to 'hit above their weight class', overcoming circumstantial disadvantages.
